detail.title: Initiating Inquiry into Accountable Cross-Turn Continuity
detail.summary: Establishing a project to investigate how durable state and constraint enforcement can unify discrete model invocations into an accountable, consistent process, utilizing current evidence on constraint satisfaction and cognitive flow augmentation.
